**Qualifies as a lead:** not until the gaps are closed

## Summary

- REAMDAY LIMITED (company number 03203769) is an active private limited company incorporated on 24 May 1996, some 30 years of trading history, operating under SIC 68209 (other letting and operating of own or leased real estate). It has a single active officer, with five officers ever appointed and no new appointments in the last 12 months. `[profile; officers; computed]`
- Two charges created on 18 July 2024 in favour of Eurobank Cyprus LTD remain outstanding, one secured on 71 Windmill Hill, Enfield EN2 7AF and the other on 75 Windmill Hill, Enfield EN2 7AF. Because these are third-party lenders, we cannot offer a first-charge facility; any new lending ranks second unless the existing charges are redeemed at completion (SEC-01). `[032037690007; 032037690006; SEC-01]`
- Both outstanding charges were created on the same day to the same lender, which points to a structured or tranched facility; full redemption figures for both are needed before any refinance is quoted (SEC-06). The company also has a history of paired same-day charges to Eurobank EFG Cyprus Limited (2011) and Cyprus Popular Bank Limited (1996). `[SEC-06; 032037690006; 032037690007; created 2011-05-26 · Eurobank Efg Cyprus Limited; created 2011-05-26 · Eurobank Efg Cyprus Limited #2; created 1996-10-14 · Cyprus Popular Bank Limited; created 1996-10-14 · Cyprus Popular Bank Limited #2]`
- Both outstanding charges carry a floating element as well as a fixed charge, which materially restricts the security available to us; an assessment of what unencumbered assets remain is required (SEC-08). `[032037690007; 032037690006; SEC-08]`
- Five earlier charges to Eurobank Cyprus Limited, Eurobank EFG Cyprus Limited and Cyprus Popular Bank Limited are recorded as fully satisfied. These are disregarded for ranking and are not a concern, though they evidence a long record of prior secured borrowing that was repaid. `[created 2013-02-05 · Eurobank Cyprus Limited; created 2011-05-26 · Eurobank Efg Cyprus Limited; created 2011-05-26 · Eurobank Efg Cyprus Limited #2; created 1996-10-14 · Cyprus Popular Bank Limited; created 1996-10-14 · Cyprus Popular Bank Limited #2; SEC-03]`
- Filing conduct is exemplary: accounts are not overdue, the most recent set was made up to 31 March 2026 and filed on 12 May 2026 (about 230 days early), with the next due 31 December 2027, and every accounts filing on record has been made ahead of its deadline. `[profile; AA filed 2026-05-12; AA filed 2025-08-05; AA filed 2024-06-24; AA filed 2023-05-04; computed]`
- The company files total-exemption full accounts, which do not disclose turnover or profit, so affordability cannot be judged from the public record. Obtain management accounts covering the most recent 12 months before any facility is offered (CON-04). `[CON-04; AA filed 2026-05-12; profile]`
